subject: general
question: The Zoological Survey of India (ZSI), with its headquarters in ______, and having presence in 16 regional stations, is responsible for surveying the faunal resources of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The headquarters of the Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) is located in Kolkata, West Bengal.
 
• The Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) was established in 1916.
 
• Motto: The motto of ZSI is "Knowledge of Animals for the Use of Mankind."
 
• It operates under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India.
